This afternoon, Dad, Mum and I went somewhere to see animals. There were puppies barking—I didn’t like them; kittens meowing—I didn’t like them; hamsters running in cages—I didn’t like them; rabbits eating grass—I didn’t like them; fish swimming—I didn’t like them; turtles that didn’t move—I didn’t like them; and birds chirping—I didn’t like them either.
